note: Monitored npm audit baseline for the Phase 21 security gate. The gate (backend/scripts/audit-gate.js) fails on ANY advisory id not listed here, so this file is the control surface: new vulnerabilities break CI until they are reviewed and either fixed or explicitly baselined (with a documented reason) via the process in docs/security/automated-testing.md.

backend.note: Runtime dependency tree. Must stay at zero — the backend is the deployed surface; any advisory here is a release blocker, not a baseline candidate.

root.note: Dev toolchain only (firebase-tools emulator cloud-SDK subtree: @opentelemetry/core, uuid — surfaced via @google-cloud/pubsub/gaxios). Two moderates, no published fix without chasing unpublished google majors; no firebase.json exists so the deploy tooling is inert. Re-audit gate before the first real deploy (see supply-chain.md).
